news.title: Chipmaker expands data-center investment
news.description: The company announced a multi-year plan to build three new facilities across Europe, citing surging demand for AI processing capacity. Construction is expected to begin next quarter.
news.author: Editorial Desk

news.title: City council approves expanded cycling network
news.description: A new set of protected bike lanes will connect the city centre to three outer neighbourhoods, part of a wider push to cut car journeys over the next decade.
news.author: Maria Lenton

news.title: Researchers report breakthrough in battery lifespan
news.description: A university team says a new electrode design could extend electric vehicle battery life by up to 40 percent, though the work has yet to be tested at commercial scale.
news.author: None

news.title: National team secures spot in final after late winner
news.description: A stoppage-time goal sent the side through to the final, sparking celebrations among travelling fans. The match had been goalless until the closing minutes.
news.author: Sports Desk
